description: Tier-1 elevated headline for the Budget Settings screen. Contains the Expenses/Income scope toggle and the Total Monthly Budget number (typography.h1). The only floating card on the screen and the only one using h1.

scope.description: Active scope; drives which categories the total sums

totalMonthlyBudget.description: Sum of limit_amount across categories in the active scope; formatted via formatCurrency from design-system

categoryCount.description: Count of categories in the active scope

rolloverCount.description: Count with rollover_enabled; the '· N with rollover' clause is omitted when 0

loading.description: Renders Skeleton pills + block instead of real content

error.description: Renders '—' as the total when the load failed

accessibility.heroLabel: Total monthly budget, {formatted}, {categoryCount} categories, {rolloverCount} with rollover
accessibility.colorIndependence: active scope shows icon + word + tint, not color alone
